script.title: Roleplay at the hotel: "I have a reservation"

lines.text: Good evening! Welcome to the hotel.
Hi, I have a reservation under Ama Brown.
Thank you, Ms. Chen. Here's your room key. Room 512.
Kit's tip: say I have a reservation under, then your name.
